steps: into a large pitcher add: either cut and juice the mango or open the can of mango puree and pour both bottles of wine if you have a glass or so of white that needs to be used , you can add that also hand squeeze lime and orange put in skins , pulp , everything make sure you washed them well ! drop in frozen berries and apple let chill 2-6 hours in the fridge just before you serve the sangria , mix in orange soda if you pour in the sida too early , it will go flat

name: Poop goop
ingredients: fig|prune|honey
steps: grind figs and prunes very fine and mix together warm the molasses stir senna into honey / molasses thoroughly take the senna and molasses that has been mixed together off heat and put in figs and prunes stir well dosage: begin with 1 / 4 teaspoon every night before bed it's a maximum dose of 1 / 2 teaspoon per day do not exceed this maximum dose !

name: Poor man s shrimp cocktail vegan
ingredients: crab boil seasoning|kosher salt|yellow onions|garlic cloves|lemons|cauliflower
steps: combine crab boil seasoning , salt , onions , garlic and six quarts of water in a large pot squeeze juice from lemons into the pot and add lemon halves set pot over high heat and bring liquid to boil boil for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld using a slotted spoon , remove onions and lemon halves discard add cauliflower , turn off heat , cover tightly and let stand until crisp tender , about 5 to 10 minutes drain spread cauliflower on baking sheet and allow to cool serve room temperature or chilled with cocktail sauce for dipping

name: Poor boy burgers
ingredients: 85% lean ground beef|onion|mushroom|parmesan cheese|green olives|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients and form into patties grill until done

name: Poor boy fried taters
ingredients: potatoes|hot dogs|cooking oil|crushed red pepper flakes|salt and pepper
steps: heat oil in skillet fry potatoes until tender add wieners and cook until plumped pepper and salt to taste i have also added onion and bell pepper on occasion

name: Poor boy loaf
ingredients: italian bread|butter|prepared mustard|fresh parsley|garlic clove|crushed red pepper flakes|tomatoes|mozzarella cheese|hard salami|pickled sweet peppers
steps: cut bread into 1 / 2 inch slices , leaving slices attached at the bottom in a small bowl , combine the butter , mustard , parsley , garlic and red pepper flakes spread on every other slice place tomatoes , mozzarella , salami and pepper rings between the buttered slices wrap in foil bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted

name: Poor boy stromboli
ingredients: pizza crust|hard salami|deli ham|swiss cheese|onion|mayonnaise
steps: lay pizza crust out on countertop and roll out so its about 1 / 4 inch thick all the way around and square in shape spread a layer of mayo on top of crust stayng about an inch away from the edges next layer cheese on top of mayo , add as much as you like , 1 - 1 1 / 2 cups is about right now layer the salami over the cheese next layer the ham over the salami finally layer the sauted onions on top of the salami starting at the edge closest to you , start to roll the dough tightly until all the toppings are enclosed in the middle , and seal the seam along the bottom and on the ends by pinching the dough together brush the top of the dough with melted butter and sprinkle poppy seeds on top cut a few slits in the top to let moisture escape put loaf on baking pan and bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minute

name: Poor girl s stroganoff
ingredients: onion|butter|ground chuck|noodles|tomato juice|salt|celery salt|worcestershire sauce|pepper|sour cream
steps: saute onion in butter remove from skillet and set aside brown the ground beef return the onion lay dry noodles over the meat and onion mixture do not stir over all , pour tomato juice mixed with salt , celery salt , worcestershire sauce and pepper cover and simmer 15 minutes , then stir cook covered 15 minutes more add sour cream stir well heat but do not boil

name: Poor knights
ingredients: bread|eggs|white wine|cinnamon|sugar|oil|confectioners' sugar
steps: cut off the bread crusts and cut into quarters be careful not to cut off your hand place the bread in a deep dish mix eggs with wine , cinnamon , and sugar in a bowl pour the mixture over the bread and leave to soak for 3 minutes heat the oil[ inch deep] drain the bread and slide it into the hot oil{watch your hands as it spits} it would definitely be to your advantage to wear a gauntlet whilst performing this procedure fry until golden brown on both sides drain on medieval kitchen paper sprinkle with confectioners sugar and ground cinnamon feed the hungry

name: Poor knights french toast fattiga riddare
ingredients: bread|egg|salt|milk|sugar|all-purpose flour|butter
steps: whisk milk , egg , flour , sugar and salt into a smooth batter preheat flat fry-pan or skillet to medium heat on stove and small amount of butter to coat the pan dip the bread-slices in the batter and fry until golden together

name: Poor man pierogi
ingredients: onion|sliced mushrooms|kielbasa|sauerkraut|unsalted butter|white wine|spiral shaped pasta|salt and pepper
steps: in a large skillet saut mushrooms and onions in stick of butter until tender add sauerkraut , sausage , white wine , salt and pepper , mix well cover and cook over medium low heat for about 1 hour add cooked spiral noodles and stick butter , stir until butter has melted , season to taste and serve

name: Poor man s baked beef in beer sauce belgian style
ingredients: beef|flour|onions|carrots|garlic cloves|sugar|vinegar|salt and pepper|oil|beer
steps: coat beef in flour discard any unused flour if any fry floured beef in skillet in medium hot oil on each side until nice and browned remove beef and arrange it evenly across the bottom of a deep metal or glass casserole pan reheat the skillet where there are still pan drippings after frying the beef fry onions until transparent remove onions and distribute over beef in casserole dish slice raw carrots and raw garlic cloves rough sliced , over top of the fried beef / onion in the casserole dish in a mixing bowl or container , combine remaining ingredients pour beer mixture over beef and vegetables in casserole dish bake covered with aluminum foil for 2-3 hours at on medium-low until meat is very tender and the other ingredients form a thick , rich sauce around the beef slow cooking is what makes this recipe work the beef comes out very rich , tender and with an amazing , rich beefy flavor it is delicious served over buttered noodles with parsley , or it can be accompanied by skillet fried potatoes or even french fries

name: Poor man s cake
ingredients: sugar|raisins|lard|allspice|clove|salt|cinnamon
steps: boil together all ingredients add water just enough water to cover raisins boil until raisins are tender cool add 1 t baking soda and enough unbleached flour to make a stiff batter pour batter into 9-inch round cake pan bake in moderate oven until cake springs back when touched lightly serve warm or cold with cream , custard sauce or powdered sugar frosting walnuts may be added to batter just before baking

name: Poor man s casserole
ingredients: hamburger meat|onion|garlic clove|salt and pepper|tomato sauce|cooked rice|corn|cheddar cheese
steps: brown the hamburger meat with the onion , garlic , salt and pepper drain the fat then add the rice , corn , and tomato sauce and mix together top with the cheese if you have a cast-iron pan put the casserole in the oven for about 5 minutes to melt the cheese if you do not have a cast-iron pan , just cover the casserole until the cheese melts

name: Poor man s casserole potato egg bacon casserole
ingredients: potatoes|bacon|hard-boiled eggs
steps: preheat the oven to 350f peel and slice the potatoes about 1 / 2 inch thick , then cook in salted water just until tender drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking cut half a pound of your favorite bacon cut into 2 inch pieces setting aside about 3 uncooked slices for top in a frying pan , cook the balance of the bacon pieces until it just starts to crisp slice the boiled eggs width wise about 1 / 4 inch thick using a deep casserole dish , layer 1 / 3 of the potatoes , 1 / 3 of the egg slices , and 1 / 2 of the cooked bacon repeat the layer for the final layer , add the remaining potatoes , eggs and the raw pieces of bacon on top i like to pour the bacon fat remaining in the frying pan over the whole dish bake uncovered in the oven for approximately 35 minutes , or until the bacon on the top is crisp enjoy

name: Poor man s caviar
ingredients: eggplants|olive oil|onion|tomatoes|green bell pepper|salt & freshly ground black pepper|lemon juice
steps: for an authentic smoky flavor , roast each unpeeled eggplant by laying it directly over a low , open , gas flame , and turn every minute with a pair of tongs until the skin is completely charred and the eggplant is very soft and limp alternatively , prick the eggplants all over and roast on a baking tray in the middle of a preheated 400 degree farhenheit oven , for 45 minutes , or until until the insides are very soft and the outsides are dry and almost crisp let the eggplants cool briefly , then peel or scrape out the flesh puree eggplant pulp in a blender heat a little olive oil in a fry pan or skillet , and fry the onion until it becomes pink-brown add the tomato , green bell pepper and salt and pepper , and cook over low to moderate heat for several minutes until soft rub as much of this mixture , as possible , through a sieve and mix with the eggplant puree check the seasonings and stir in the lemon juice , adding a teaspoon more at a time , to taste , if desired the consistency should be that of thick mayonnaise garnish with freshly chopped parsley and serve , as an appetiser , with chunks of turkish bread

name: Poor man s chicken fried steak
ingredients: hamburger meat|egg|cracker|salt and pepper|oil
steps: heat a small amount of oil in your pan for frying mix up meat and salt and pepper form into patties dip in the egg roll in cracker crumbs place in the oil and cook until needing to be flipped then flip and finish until desired doneness can be topped with mushroom soup for gravy or you can make a milk gravy other substitutions are adding garlic powder or onion soup mix or worcestershire sauce

name: Poor man s cooked frosting
ingredients: milk|flour|salt|sugar|margarine|vegetable shortening|vanilla
steps: in saucepan , cook milk , flour and salt until thick cool well in small mixing bowl add sugar , margarine and shortening beat well with electric mixer add flour mixture and 1 teaspoon vanilla beat until it is fluffy and stiff like whipped cream

name: Poor man s cookies
ingredients: rolled oats|brown sugar|sugar|all-purpose flour|salt|baking soda|hot water|shortening|vanilla extract
steps: heat oven to 350 degrees in a mixing bowl , combine oats , sugars , flour and salt combine soda and water stir into oats mixture along with shortening and vanilla roll into walnut size balls bake at 350 for about 10 minutes or until golden brown remove from the oven and allow to stand 2 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool

name: Poor man s crab bake
ingredients: cod fish fillet|butter|herb seasoned stuffing mix|frozen crabmeat|mushroom stems and pieces|egg|fresh parsley|salt|lemon juice|hot pepper sauce
steps: heat oven to 350 in ungreased baking dish , place cod fillets in medium bowl , mix together all crab mixture ingredients sprinkle crab mixture over cod in same bowl , combine topping ingredients and sprinkle over crab mixture bake 30-35 minutes or until heated through and fish flakes with a fork

name: Poor man s dinner party
ingredients: ground beef|shortening|onion|canned tomatoes|catsup|steak sauce|green pepper|parsley|elbow macaroni|cream of mushroom soup|cheddar cheese|salt and pepper
steps: brown ground been in shortening until all red color disappears drain all but 1 1 / 2 tsp grease from the skillet add the onion , tomatoes , catsup , steak sauce , green pepper , and parsley simmer for 30 minutes meanwhile , cook the macaroni according to package directions combine macaroni and ground beef mixture in a 2 quart baking dish season with salt and pepper to taste , keeping in mind that you will be adding a cream of soup gently spoon mushroom soup into mixture mix lightly , lifting from the bottom sprinkle 1 / 2 cup cheese into the mix and stir add the other 1 cup of cheese on the top bake at 350f for 30 minutes , or until top is bubbly and browned

name: Poor man s eggs benedict sans sauce
ingredients: english muffin|deviled ham|mayonnaise|eggs
steps: i always keep a container of deviled ham mixed with mayo in the fridge the proportion for the mix are up to your taste i use about 1 heaping tablesoon for each 4 25 oz can of underwood deviled ham toast the halves of one sandwich size english muffin , i use thomas' spread deviled ham mix to cover each half fry 2 eggs to your taste soft yolks best for this put one egg on each english muffin half and enjoy !

name: Poor man s feast
ingredients: vegetable oil|onion|potatoes|hot dogs|tomato sauce|salt|sugar
steps: prepare the vegetables: dice the onion peel the potatoes and dice into cubes no larger than 1 / 2 inch heat the oil in a 12" non-stick skillet over medium heat add the potatoes and cook for 5 minutes , stirring once add the onion and cook for another 5 minutes , stirring occasionally add the sliced wieners and cook for another 5 minutes , stirring occasionally add the tomato sauce , salt , and sugar and stir let simmer gently , stirring occasionally , for another 10 minutes or so , until the potatoes are cooked through

name: Poor man s food
ingredients: diced tomatoes|jumbo pasta shells|garlic powder|salt|pepper
steps: in a large pot boil water and pasta till al dente add in the tomatoes , seasoning and cook till pasta is tender and enjoy additional: if adding meat brown in a skillet and add to pasta once tender

name: Poor man s granola bar
ingredients: flour|granola cereal|oatmeal|baking powder|cinnamon|margarine|honey|eggs|vanilla|raisins
steps: preheat oven to 350 mix dry ingredients in large bowl beat remaining ingredients in another bowl fold into dry ingredients mix in raisins mush into bottom of greased "bar" pan bake for about 20 minutes let cool cut into 2 x 4 bars and store

name: Poor man s ground elk meat wellington
ingredients: ground elk|breadcrumbs|worcestershire sauce|black forest ham|onion soup mix|egg|pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls|mozzarella cheese
steps: unroll crescent rolls and roll seams together mix elk meat , egg , bread crumbs , worcestershire sauce and onion soup mix and spread over dough sprinkle the cheese over meat and lay thin slices of ham over the cheese roll and pinch ends together and put on clay stone bake at 375 degrees f for 45 min and let stand for 20 minutes slice and serve will serve six adults

name: Poor man s lasagna
ingredients: lean ground beef|pasta sauce|pasta|egg|fat-free cottage cheese|cheese
steps: brown meat in a skillet drain fat from meat meanwhile , boil noodles according to package directions meanwhile mix the egg and cottage cheese in a bowl , and set aside spray a 9x13 pyrex coat the bottom with a very thin layer of pasta sauce layer about half of the noodles on top of the sauce layer the meat on top of that , followed by another thin layer of sauce layer the cottage cheese mixture on top of that , followed by the remaining noodles add the remaining sauce on top of the noodles sprinkle all of the cheese on top of the lasagna bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes depending on how crunchy you like your noodles i have found that half of a container of cottage cheese is perfect , so i usually go ahead and mix the remaining half with an egg , and freeze it it defrosts quite easily in the fridge next time i also usually buy the meat on sale in bulk , and freeze it in pre-cooked portions if you do that , you can easily put this meal together quickly it's also easy to make 2 lasagnas at once , and freeze one for later you can reheat it in the microwave , or in the oven at 350 for 20 minutes , covered

name: Poor man s lobster
ingredients: water|salt|cod fish fillets|sugar|ketchup|horseradish|lemon juice
steps: bring water to a boil add sugar , salt and fish simmer until fish turns white , 5 to 8 minutes drain and chill flake the cooked , and chilled fish stir together lemon juice , ketchup and horseradish and mix well with cod serve cold with lemon wedges

name: Poor man s lobster 1
ingredients: haddock|vinegar|salt|butter
steps: cover filets with cold water and add vinegar and salt bring to a boil and boil for only 10 minutes serve with melted butter fish may also be place under the broiler 1-2 minutes to brown

name: Poor man s lobster mahi mahi
ingredients: mahi mahi fillet|beer|lemon juice|butter|garlic|salt
steps: cut fillets into 2 inch chunks and drizzle with the lemon juice pour the beer into the bottom of a saucepan and place a collapsible vegetable steamer over the beer bring the beer to a boil , place the fish chunks in the steamer , cover and steam for 5 to 10 minutes , dependent upon the thickness of the fish the fish will be rubbery if it is overcooked meanwhile , heat the butter with the garlic and salt remove the fish from the steamer and discard the beer / liquid / rind serve the fish chunks with the garlic butter dipping sauce

name: Poor man s lobster butter baked cod
ingredients: cod fish fillets|butter|kosher salt|pepper|paprika|fresh parsley sprig|lemon slice
steps: preheat oven to 375 arrange fish in a shallow casserole pour half the melted butter over the fillets sprinkle with salt , pepper , and paprika place the fish in the oven and bake , uncovered , basting occasionally , until the fish flakes with fork , about 15-20 minutes garnish with parsley serve with lemon slices and the remaining melted butter for dipping

name: Poor man s lobster newburg
ingredients: imitation lobster meat|butter|paprika|whipping cream|worcestershire sauce|egg yolks|sherry wine|salt|butter flavored cracker
steps: in a skillet , sautee the lobster in butter along with paprika , until browned set aside in a saucepan , combine the cream and worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil combine beaten egg yolks , sherry or water and salt remove cream mixture from heat and slowly stir in egg mixture return pan bringing this to a boil and cook while stirring for 5-7 minutes or until thickened stir in lobster pour mixture into a shallow 9 inch pie plate or divide between four 10oz individual baking dishes sprinkle with the cracker crumbs and broil 6 inches from heat for about 2 minutes or until a golden brown

name: Poor man s mac cheese casserole
ingredients: ground beef|cream-style corn|whole corn|peas|kraft macaroni and cheese
steps: brown ground beef and set aside and keep warm or brown while cooking mac & cheese cook macaroni & cheese according to directions on box add ground beef , cream style corn , drained whole corn , and drained peas to macaroni and cheese and you're done ! if it's to dry for your taste just add some more milk frozen corn and peas can be used if you prefer

name: Poor man s pie
ingredients: 9 inch pie shell|brown sugar|flour|salt|light cream|butter
steps: preheat oven to 400f line a large 9-inch pie plate with rolled out pastry dough , prick with a fork and bake for 10 minutes remove from oven and reduce heat to 350f in a small bowl , combine sugar , flour and salt mix well and spread evenly over the bottom of the crust warm cream in the microwave , and then carefully pour the warmed cream over the sugar mixture , completely covering it in bits , dab butter over the cream bake at 350f for 45 minutes to an hour , or until golden spots form on the top the filling will seem liquid but will become firmer as it cools

name: Poor man s pie gluten free dairy free
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|worcestershire sauce|beef broth|gluten-free flour|onion salt|pepper|frozen mixed vegetables|mashed potatoes
steps: preheat oven to 375f in a frying pan , cook the beef with the onions until the latter are translucent stir in the worcestershire sauce drain the drippings into a 2-quart glass measure and place the meat mix in a 2-quart casserole dish to the pan drippings , add the beef broth to make 2 cups in the frying pan , place flour mix and stir in the broth cook over medium heat , stirring , until the gravy is thick season with onion salt and pepper and pour about half of the broth over the meat top with the mixed vegetables and spoon the mashed potatoes on top bake , uncovered , for 30 minutes serve with the remaining warmed gravy

name: Poor man s pierogies
ingredients: lasagna noodles|butter|onions|potatoes|salt and black pepper|velveeta cheese|parmesan cheese
steps: saute onion in 1 stick butter until tender cook noodles as directed on box boil potatoes , then mash add cubed cheese , salt , pepper , and remaining butter to potatoes and mix until well combined put layer of noodles in 9x13-inch baking dish layer 1 / 3 of sauteed onions over noodles , then 1 / 3 of potato mixture repeat layers , ending with potatoes on top sprinkle with parmesan cheese bake at 350f for 30-35 minutes

name: Poor man s pizza
ingredients: ritz crackers|ketchup|cheddar cheese|pepperoni slices
steps: place ritz cracker salt side down and top with a little ketchup add cheese and pepperoni heat in microwave until cheese melts !

name: Poor man s pudding
ingredients: butter|brown sugar|hot water|sugar|milk|flour|baking powder|salt
steps: preheat the oven to 350 degrees mix 1 tablespoon butter , brown sugar and hot water in the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch baking pan in a separate bowl , mix together the remaining butter and sugar add flour and baking powder alternately with milk pour over brown sugar mixture in baking dish bake 30 minutes

name: Poor man s pudding pouding chomeur
ingredients: maple syrup|35% cream|butter|sugar|eggs|flour|baking powder|salt|milk
steps: preheat the oven to 400f in a large heavy pan , bring to a boil the maple syrup and the cream pay close attention , because it will boil over ! once a slow roll begins , continue for about 3 to 4 minutes , and remove from the heat with an electric beater , beat the butter and the sugar together add the eggs and continue beating for about 2 minutes sift together the flour , baking powder and the salt add the dry ingredients into the the egg mixture , alternating with the milk pour the batter into a 13x9-inch pan pour the maple syrup / cream mix on top bake for 30 minutes enjoy with vanilla ice cream , whipped cream , or all by itself ! before adding anything , put in one or two frozen raspberries , then the batter , followed by the maple / cream mix makes an impressive and tasty quick dessert on a cold winter night for guests

name: Poor man s pudding cake pouding chomeur
ingredients: brown sugar|water|butter|vanilla|sugar|milk|salt|flour|baking powder
steps: in a saucepan melt butter or margarine stir in brown sugar add water and vanilla bring to a boil meanwhile , make the dough cream butter or margarine add sugar in a separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt add to butter mixture alternately with milk pour syrup into a 9 x 13 baking dish drop dough by teaspoons over syrup bake at 350 f for 30 minutes

name: Poor man s purim cake
ingredients: sugar|unsalted butter|eggs|milk|all-purpose flour|baking powder|lemon rind|confectioners' sugar
steps: place the sugar and the butter together in a food processor with the steel blade and process until creamed add the eggs and the milk , pulsing after each addition then add the flour , baking powder , and the lemon rind , pulsing until a smooth mass is formed place the dough in a greased and floured 9- by 9-inch square baking pan pat down and bake in a preheated 350f oven for 30 minutes when cool enough to handle , turn out on a rack sprinkle with confectioners sugar , slice , and serve

name: Poor man s rabbit
ingredients: rabbit|flour|salt|fresh ground black pepper|olive oil|onion|garlic cloves|red wine|bouquet garni|veal stock|white pearl onion|mushrooms
steps: dredge rabbit pieces , including liver , in flour , then shake to remove all but a light dusting salt and pepper each piece heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and brown rabbit on all sides until golden remove from pan and set aside in same pan , heat 1 tablespoons of the oil and saut onions and garlic over medium heat until tender add 1 / 2 cup of the wine to pan and raise heat cook until most of the wine has evaporated , stirring constantly to loosen any browned bits on the bottom add remaining 1 1 / 2 cups wine , bouquet garni , and veal stock cook for 5 minutes return rabbit to pan , cover , lower heat , and slowly simmer for 1 1 / 21 3 / 4 hours or until rabbit is very tender meanwhile , blanch pearl onions in a pot of boiling water for 1 minute drain and peel by cutting off root ends and squeezing onions out of skin saut whole mushrooms and pearl onions over medium heat in remaining 1 tablespoons oil until golden , about 15 minutes season to taste with salt and pepper when rabbit is cooked , remove from pan , cover , and keep warm discard bouquet garni , mash the liver in pan , then strain the sauce , pushing as many of the solids as possible through the strainer return sauce to pan , add rabbit , mushrooms , and onions simmer for 5 minutes to heat through , then serve

name: Poor man s rice beef
ingredients: ground beef|dried mushroom|garlic powder|pepper|frozen carrots|tomato sauce|water|rice
steps: brown meat in saucepan drain meat add sauce , mushrooms , carrots , seasonings , rice & water bring to a slight boil cover saucepan reduce heat cook covered until rice is done enjoy

name: Poor man s roast
ingredients: bologna|orange juice|brown sugar|orange zest
steps: score bologna with cross cuts baste with glaze made with next 3 ingredients bake at 325f for 1 hour in covered casserole baste at least once more and when done to your liking

name: Poor man s shepherd s pie
ingredients: ground chuck|tomato soup|whole kernel corn|mashed potatoes|cheese
steps: brown ground chuck with onions and seasonings to taste add tomato soup and corn top with mashed potatoes and shredded cheese pop in oven until cheese melts

name: Poor man s spaghetti
ingredients: hamburger|onion|spaghetti noodles|tomato soup|salt|pepper
steps: 1 brown hamburger and onion season to taste 2 add tomato soup and 1 can of water 3 cover and simmer while cooking spaghetti 4 cook spaghetti according to package directions 5 when spaghetti is done , drain and mix with meat / soup season to taste 6 let set about 10 minutes for noodles to absorb some of the sauce

name: Poor man s steak
ingredients: ground beef|onion|saltine crackers|water|condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: mix everything except the soup together , adding whatever seasonings you like form into serving sized patties in a skillet , brown the patties on both sides spray pam on the bottom of a small roaster pan and place patties into the roaster spread the cream of mushroom soup over the top of the patties bake covered at 325 degrees for 1 hour this makes a yummy tasting gravy that goes well with potatoes , noodles , or rice

name: Poor man s stew
ingredients: ground beef|potatoes|carrots|cream of celery soup|kernel corn
steps: boil water in a large pot add carrots and potatoes and boil 10-15 minutes until tender drain and set aside meanwhile , brown meat in a large skillet drain well add 3 / 4 or full can of corn to meat in a small pot combine soup and corn juice heat over med-low until warm add potato and carrots to meat pour soup over top and stir gently heat if neccesary

name: Poor man s stew dairy free
ingredients: ground beef|onion|bay leaves|consomme|black pepper|garlic powder|oregano|carrots|potatoes|cornstarch
steps: brown ground beef in sauce pan place browned ground beef in large pot with 1 medium onion- diced , bay leafs , soups add pepper , garlic powder , oregano , sliced carrots and potatoes simmer - 1 hour thicken with 2 tbs of corn starch gradually enjoy with fresh bread edited to add - i made it a few days ago with beef broth and it was just as good :)

name: Poor man s t bone steak
ingredients: chuck roast|vegetable oil|worcestershire sauce|liquid smoke|soy sauce|vinegar|garlic cloves|celery salt|dry mustard|ginger|brown sugar
steps: pierce the roast with a fork on both sides mix all marinade ingredients together pour over the chuck roast in a marinade pan or zip-lock bag refrigerate overnight or up to two days , turning several times grill it as you would steak let rest a few minutes , slice and serve

name: Poor man s tuna casserole
ingredients: kraft macaroni and cheese|tuna|cream of mushroom soup|frozen peas|cheddar cheese|french-fried onions
steps: cook macaroni and cheese according to box directions stir in tuna , cream of mushroom soup , and frozen peas transfer mixture to baking dish and top with shredded cheese and french fried onions bake at 375 degrees until cheese is melted , and dish is heated through enjoy ! if you are low on time , or don't want to heat up the oven , you can omit the cheese and french friend onions , and simply warm through on the stovetop

name: Poor mans barbecue sauce
ingredients: ketchup|hot sauce|soy sauce|sugar|mustard|salt|pepper
steps: mix all ingredients together let stand for approximately 15 minutes or longer

name: Poor mans bars
ingredients: raisins|water|butter|sugar|egg|flour|baking soda|cinnamon|salt|vanilla|lemon juice
steps: cook raisins in water til there is 1 cup of water left add sugar and butter while rasins are hot then add dry ingredients and egg and vanilla put in pam sprayed pan bake 10 minutes at 400 degrees im guessing a cookie sheet here guys

name: Poor mans pieroghi
ingredients: lasagna noodles|potatoes|cheddar cheese|butter|onion|polska kielbasa
steps: cook lasagna noodles according to package directions meanwhile , cook peeled potatoes until done grate or cube cheddar cheese when noodles are done , drain and run cold water over them , place on surface and cut in half combine cooked , drained potatoes and cheese in large bowl mix for 2 minutes on high speed until blended well , about 2 minutes place about 3-4 tablespoons of potato / cheese mixture in each noodle roll up arrange in a deep 8x12 pan over medium high heat in a saucepan , melt butter and add chopped onions cook until tender pour butter mixture over the pieroghi slice keilbasa lenghtwise and place on top of pieroghi mixture bake at 350% for 45 minutes

name: Poor mans skillet beef stew
ingredients: beef bouillon cubes|yellow onion|baby carrots|ground beef|potatoes|salt|pepper|water
steps: brown the ground beef drain and , add 1 / 2 to 1 cup water add the carrots and let simmer on med / high heat until cooked halfway through add the large onion cut into quarters and simmer on med / high heat for a little while longer when onions and veggies become tender you add your boullion and let melt down thoroughly , mixing well with the meat and veggies , and add your salt and pepper to suit your taste throw over some rice or noodles can also add cabbage , peas and double all the ingredients except for the beef and make a nice hearty soup )

name: Poor woman s chicken wellington
ingredients: shallot|butter|white mushrooms|chicken tenderloins|garlic clove|cayenne pepper|white wine|puff pastry sheets|chicken bouillon cube|campbell's cream of mushroom soup
steps: using a stock pot i heat up the wine , shallots , garlic , butter , and bouillon on medium temperature when wine has reduced somewhat and garlic is fragrant add chicken cook on med high temperature when chicken has cooked in the fragrant wine broth , add mushrooms continue to cook for about 3 minutes and then add remaining ingredients and stir cook for another 5 minutes and watch as it reduces using a loaf pan i layer pastry sheets between the chicken / mushroom sauce on final layer of pastry i brush a little egg wash on for shine then bake at 350f until the pastry is flaky / puffed / golden brown enjoy !

name: Poor woman s pie
ingredients: hamburger|onion|green pepper|mixed vegetables|cream of mushroom soup|water|instant mashed potatoes|milk|margarine|cheddar cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350 in a pan , brown hamburger along with onion and pepper drain return to pan and add veggies , soup , and 1 / 2 cup water stir until well mixed while browning hamburger , in a different pan add 1 1 / 2 cups water , milk , and butter and bring to boil then add package of potatoes , and fluff with fork in a greased 2 quart casserole , pour hamburger mixture first then cover with half of cheese add potatoes on top then add remainder of cheese bake for 15 minutes , or until cheese is melted and bubbly

name: Poor woman s tagine
ingredients: water|brown rice|lentils|salt|diced onion|diced tomato|carrots|raisins|garlic powder|cinnamon|dried celery flakes|chili powder
steps: preheat the oven to 300f combine all ingredients in a baking dish and cover with foil bake covered for 1 hour and 30 minutes let sit covered for at least 15 minutes before eating even better the next day , after the flavors have developed a bit more

name: Poor man canadian poutine
ingredients: vegetable oil|beef gravy|potatoes|cheese curds
steps: heat oil in a deep fryer or deep heavy skillet to 365f warm gravy in saucepan or microwave place the fries into the hot oil , and cook until light brown , about 5 minutes remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain place the fries on a serving platter , and sprinkle the cheese over them ladle gravy over the fries and cheese , and serve immediately

name: Poor man s pate
ingredients: liverwurst|cream cheese|pickle relish|bacon bits|shallot|hot sauce
steps: in a food processor mix all ingredients except for 1 teaspoon of the bacon bits till combined place on a serving platter then top with remaining bits serve with crackers of your choice

name: Poori
ingredients: all-purpose flour|whole wheat flour|salt|oil
steps: sift all purpose flour and salt add 1 / 2 tbsp oil knead lightly add water and knead well till becomes soft water should be added gradually keep aside covered for about 20 minutes divide into about 10 portions roll out each portion into a round size of about four inch diameter heat oil to very hot in a deep frying pan fry one at a time with light tapping so that it puffs , turn over till light golden drain and remove serve hot with any curry or can be taken as it is too much kneading with oil will make very crunchy luchis but luchis should be soft and puffed

name: Pooris fried indian bread
ingredients: whole wheat flour|canola oil|salt|hot water
steps: put the flour and salt into a medium-sized bowl pour the oil and hot water on top mix together with hands until it becomes a soft dough cover the dough with a damp towel to keep it moist let the dough sit for 30 minutes sprinkle some flour on the counter and knead the dough for a couple of minutes divide the dough into 6 equal parts roll each piece into a 6-inch circle be sure to cover each circle with a cloth to keep from drying out heat a couple of tablespoons of canola oil in a skillet when the skillet is hot , fry one circle of dough at a time , adding a little oil with each fry 15-20 seconds on each side until the it is puffed and golden serve hot

name: Poorman s cake
ingredients: raisins|lard|water|applesauce|sugar|flour|nutmeg|cinnamon|baking soda|salt|gumdrop|walnuts|dates|candied fruit
steps: boil together: raisins , lard , applesauce , and 1 cup water add sugar , cold water and dry ingredients to hot mixture , mixing well stir in the rest of ingredients pour into a buttered cake pan bake at 325 degrees for 90 minutes or until done may be served with whipped cream or white sauce

name: Poorman s creole
ingredients: onion|celery|green bell pepper|garlic clove|olive oil|tomatoes|tomato sauce|salt|sugar|bay leaf|chili powder|worcestershire sauce|hominy|cornstarch|tuna|tabasco sauce
steps: cook onion , celery , green bell peppers and garlic in hot oil until tender but not brown add tomatoes , tomato sauce and seasonings , and hominy simmer uncovered about 45 minutes stirring occasionally mix cornstarch and 2 teaspoon water , stir into sauce add canned tuna simmer 5 minutes serve over rice

name: Poorman s lasagna
ingredients: spiral shaped pasta|mushrooms|onion|garlic|spaghetti sauce|hamburger|mozzarella cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f cook macaroni according to package directions sautee onion , garlic and mushrooms add hamburger when hamburger is browned , drain fat add spaghetti sauce and heat add sauce mixture to drained macaroni in one quart casserole dish , spoon in macaroni mixture , topping it with cheese keep layering until mixture reaches the top bake for 30 minutes

name: Poorman s lobster 2
ingredients: haddock|cream of shrimp soup|celery|onion|garlic powder|seasoning salt|white pepper|ritz cracker|butter
steps: saute celery and onion in olive oil to release flavors add soup and seasonings , heat slightly and adjust seasonings place haddock in a 2 quart baking dish , pour soup mixture over haddock and bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees remove from oven mix topping ingredients together srinkle crumb mixture over top and return to the oven for 10-15 minutes

name: Poorman s mocha latte
ingredients: hot chocolate powder|brewed coffee
steps: really simple brew coffee pour packet of coco into empty mug pour coffee over coco , stir and enjoy , adding creamer to personal taste

name: Poorman s shake and bake
ingredients: flour|cayenne pepper|all-bran cereal|parsley flakes|garlic powder|onion powder|chili powder|taco seasoning|pepper|curry|sweet basil|oregano
steps: mix the flour , cayenne pepper , all-bran cereal , parsley flakes , garlic powder , onion powder , chili powder , taco seasoning , season pepper , curry , basil and oregano together i use a large size zipper plastic bag and keep it in the freezer use for coating any and all types of meat you can add more of the cayenne and chili powder if you so desire i usually just throw in what i have at the time i make it so it is never the same twice it is a great all-around coating

name: Poorman s stroganoff
ingredients: butter|egg noodles|onion|fresh button mushrooms|ground beef|tomato sauce|beef broth|flour|salt and pepper|sour cream|shredded cheddar cheese
steps: cook and drain the noodles and place is butter 9x13" casserole saute onion and mushrooms in the butter or margarine , remove from skillet and brown the ground beef drain beef and return to pan with onions and mushrooms add tomato sauce and beef broth and simmer to reduce somewhat sprinkle in the flour and blend salt and pepper to taste simmer about 10 minutes while shredding cheese fold in the sour cream and pour mixture over the noodles sprinkle with the cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes in a 375 degree oven

name: Poorman s toffee
ingredients: saltine crackers|chocolate chips|brown sugar|butter|walnuts
steps: cover a cookie sheet with aluminum foil , then line with crackers preheat oven to 350 f in a sauce pan , melt butter and brown sugar over medium heat until it reaches hard ball texture - 250f on a candy thermomator or if you don't have one when a small amount is dripped into chilled water a ball is formed that is rigid but still pliable pour the mixture over crackers and put in the oven until bubblely take out and sprinkle chocolate chips over crackers and candy then return to oven until the chocolate chips melt a little remove from oven again and spread chocolate evenly around , sprinkle with walnuts if you wish chill in the refrigerator for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours then peel off foil and break or cut into pieces

name: Pop em pizza bites
ingredients: pizza dough|mozzarella cheese|pepperoni|olive oil|dried italian seasoning|parmesan cheese|pizza sauce
steps: preheat oven to 400 spray 3 9-inch pie pans with cooking spray on lightly floured surface , roll out one pizza crust and pat into 12x8 rectangle cut into 24 squares place one pepperoni slice and one cube of cheese on each dough square wrap dough around , pressing to seal place in pans , seamside down repeat with remaining dough , pepperoni and cheese mix together oil and italian seasoning drizzle or brush over rolls top with grated parmesan bake at 400 for 16-20 minutes or until golden brown serve with warmed pizza or marinara sauce to freeze: flash freeze on a cookie sheet until frozen solid , label and place in a ziplock bag to reheat: microwave approximately 30 seconds or more to heat through

name: Pop culture popcorn with 6 mixes
ingredients: popcorn|butter
steps: pop popcorn according to microwave directions add seasoning immediately bacon & herb: 1 / 4 cup fresh grated parmesan and 2 tablespoon real bacon bits ground together in a coffee grinder or mini food processor , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons parsley flakes , 3 / 4 teaspoons garlic powder , 3 / 4 teaspoons onion powder , 3 / 4 teaspoon sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoons paprika makes 10 tablespoons toss 5 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn apple cinnamon: 1 1 / 3 cup freeze dried apples or apple chips , 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon grind ingredients in a coffee grinder or mini food processor makes 12 tablespoons tos 6 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn butterscotch: place 8 butterscotch hard candies in a coffee grinder or mini food processor until finely crushed toss with 1 bag popcorn barbecue: 3 3 / 4 teaspoons smoked paprika , 3 1 / 2 teaspoons garlic powder , 2 1 / 2 tablespoons light brown sugar , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley flakes makes 12 tablespoons toss 4 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn sweet chili: 3 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , 1 tablespoons chili powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne pepper or more to taste , and 1 1 / 2 teaspoon paprika makes 9 tablespoons toss about 2 1 / 2 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn chocolate malt: 6 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa , 6 tablespoons malted milk powder makes 15 tablespoons toss 5 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn

name: Pop in the mouth meatballs
ingredients: cooking spray|ground turkey|scallion|breadcrumbs|currants|fresh parsley|of fresh mint|egg white|salt|cinnamon|cayenne
steps: coat a 10 by 15 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray in a large bowl , combine ground turkey , scallions , bread crumbs , currants , parsley , mint , egg white , salt , cinnamon , and cayenne mix lightly to combine shape in to 1 inch balls and place on prepared pan refrigerate 1 hour preheat oven to 350 bake meatballs for 10 minutes transfer pan to broiler and broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 3-5 minutes , until lightly browned

name: Pop pop s goulash
ingredients: ground beef|green pepper|onion|elbow macaroni|campbell's condensed tomato soup|cheese
steps: cook and drain noodles brown beef with peppers and onion until done and drain mix ingredients in large pot and heat through , do not add water

name: Pop pop s roast leg of lamb
ingredients: leg of lamb|garlic cloves|olive oil|savory|rosemary|salt|ground pepper
steps: preheat oven to 400f score 1 / 4 inch deep diamonds in lamb mash & chop garlic into fine peices and mix together with olive oil , savory , rosemary , salt & pepper insert and rub mixture all over lamb reduce oven temperature to 325 and bake about 30-35 minutes per pound for a 6-8 lb roast or use a digital meat thermometer enjoy !

name: Pop pop s turkey chili
ingredients: vegetable oil|onions|celery|garlic cloves|ground turkey|tomato sauce|chili powder|ground cumin|red kidney beans|salt and pepper
steps: heat oil and saute onion , celery , and garlic until onion is golden add turkey , saute until turkey is no longer pink , breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks add tomato sauce , chili powder , and cumin and stir bring to a boil , reduce to low , cover and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally mix in beans , salt , and pepper cover and simmer 30 minutes

name: Pop rocks no bake strawberry lime cheesecake
ingredients: graham cracker crumbs|pecan sandies|butter|white sugar|strawberry soda pop rocks candy|cream cheese|lime juice|heavy whipping cream|fresh strawberries
steps: in a bowl , mix together crushed cookies and graham crackers with melted butter and the 3 tablespoons sugar wait , a little bit for the butter to cool down and then combine the pop rocks gently into the crushed mixture press into a 7 inch spring-form pan place in refrigerator until ready for use in another bowl , beat cream cheese , 1 / 3 cup of sugar and lemon juice whip cream , and fold into cream cheese mixture spread into pan top with sliced strawberries freeze for 1 hour , covered with foil place in refrigerator 30 minutes before serving garnish with lime zest before serving

name: Pop tart trifle
ingredients: strawberry pop tarts|prepared vanilla pudding|frozen strawberries|fresh strawberries|whipped cream
steps: in a trifle dish or clear round glass bowl , crumble 2 pop tarts spread 1 can of vanilla pudding evenly over crumbled pop tarts top with 2 more crumbled pop tarts cover with 1 / 2 of the defrosted strawberries top strawberry layer with the second can of pudding , then the remaining frozen strawberries , and crumble last two pop tarts over that garnish with whipped cream and fresh strawberries refrigerate any leftovers

name: Pop up cajun popcorn
ingredients: canola oil|cajun seasoning|popcorn
steps: add the oil , seasoning and popcorn to a large pan heat over medium heat until popping ends serve warm

name: Pop up pizza casserole
ingredients: ground chuck|onion|green pepper|oregano|garlic|spaghetti sauce|mozzarella cheese|milk|oil|eggs|salt|flour|parmesan cheese
steps: brown meat add all but cheese simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally in a small bowl , beat the milk , oil and eggs for 1 minute on medium speed add flour and salt , beat 2 minutes more on medium speed until smooth pour hot meat mixture into a 13x9 inch pan place cheese on top pour batter over cheese , covering filling completely sprinkle with parmesan cheese bake 25-30 minutes at 400 degrees serve immediately

name: Pop up rolls
ingredients: self rising flour|milk|sugar|mayonnaise
steps: please be sure to use self rising flour and not all-purpose flour ! mix all ingredients until thoroughly combined grease cups of a muffin / cupcake pan with butter use lots of butter to make the sides of the rolls crisp fill cups full bake at 375 for 18-20 minutes

name: Pop s half sour pickles
ingredients: pickling cucumbers|garlic cloves|pickling salt|pickling spices|warm water
steps: scrub cucumbers under cold water pack whole tightly in jar in a seperate bowl , mix water , garlic , pickling salt , and pickling spice stir well and pour over cucumbers add additional warm water , if needed , to fill the jar cover and refrigerate 4-5 days for maximum flavor

name: Pop s pickled bell peppers
ingredients: white vinegar|water|sugar|bell pepper|garlic clove
steps: in medium size saucepan , simmer vinegar , water and sugar for 5 minutes slice peppers , removing seeds place peppers in glass jar pour liquid mixture over peppers leaving 1 / 2-inch headspace allow to cool and then place tight fitting lid on store in refrigerator best if left in refrigerator to marinate for at least 24-48 hours before serving the longer they marinate , more garlic flavor is absorbed will last for 2 weeks or more in refrigerator

name: Pop s roast turkey sandwich
ingredients: cinnamon raisin bread|unsalted butter|cooked turkey|apricot jam|mayonnaise|havarti cheese|granny smith apples|lettuce leaves
steps: lightly toast the bread and spread with butter to taste roll up the turkey into logs and place on one piece of bread top with cheese , apple slices , and lettuce spread apricot jam and mayo onto the other slice of bread and place on top of the other slice poke a toothpick on each side of the sandwich to hold it together , then cut through the center , on a slight diagonal

name: Pop s texas fried egg sandwich
ingredients: egg|butter|cheese|bread|salt and pepper|mayonnaise|onion|tomatoes|ham
steps: in a skillet melt the butter over medium heat crack the egg and add to the pan and cook to desired doneness i usually break the yolk and flip it over so it isn't too runny toast the bread and put mayonnaise or miracle whip on the bread add salt and pepper to taste on the egg and the tomato slices add egg onto toast add cheese slice onto egg while the egg is still hot after you remove the egg from the pan , put the meat into the pan to heat it up / pan fry it to your liking i keep mine in the skillet until it's just a smidge brown i do fry it on both sides after the meat is done , put it on top of the cheese add slice of onion add slice of tomato put the other piece of bread on top serve warm grab a napkin , because these are messy !

name: Pop pop potatoes
ingredients: potato|olive oil|dried oregano|garlic salt|salt and pepper
steps: ok -- dad's directions go like this -- cut , nuke , slash , oil , season which for the rest of us really means: wash the spuds and halve them , then cook them in the microwave until almost fully done pull them out , slash cross-hatches in them and oil with a brush , then season them as liberally as you like put them out on the grill on the top rack for "two beers worth" of time until nicely browned and kinda crusty on the bottom if you like you can also do them in the oven like me along with the casserole or meat that is already in there at 350 or higher they might not get as brown , but are still very yummy !

name: Pop pop s chili
ingredients: olive oil|onion|ground beef|garlic|bay leaf|oregano|chili powder|cumin|cayenne pepper|kidney beans|tomato sauce
steps: heat oil in small dutch oven and saute onion , garlic and meat until meat is no longer pink drain any fat from the pan add seasonings , then beans and tomato sauce cook on low about 1 / 2 hour serve with grated cheese for topping

name: Pop up pizza
ingredients: refrigerated buttermilk biscuits|spaghetti sauce|mozzarella cheese|onion|bell pepper|sausage|ground beef|ham|pineapple|pepperoni|mushroom
steps: in a casserole dish , place cut up biscuits cover with spaghetti sauce spread toppings of your choice over spaghetti sauce then pile on the cheese cook at 400 degrees for 26 minutes , checking periodically

name: Pop up rolls
ingredients: all-purpose flour|baking powder|salt|milk|sugar|butter
steps: in a bowl , stir together all ingredients until thoroughly combined fill greased muffin cups half full bake at 375 for 18-20 minute or until lightly browned yield: 9 rolls

name: Pop up rolls
ingredients: self rising flour|milk|sugar|mayonnaise
steps: combine everything fill greased muffin tins half full bake 375 , for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown

name: Popcorn
ingredients: popcorn|salt|oil
steps: i use my spice grinder , which is a coffee grinder i use only to grind spices , to make my salt fine place oil and salt in a stir-fry pan or wok on stove top stir oil and salt until salt is disolved in oil i use a rubber spattula add popcorn and stir the corn until it is covered with the oil cover pan with lid but leave a gap for the steam to escape i don't use a lid , but instead put aluminum foil over the pan and poke holes in it to let the steam out turn heat on high and shake pan a couple of times to level out the corn wait for corn to begin to pop and then shake pan occasionally when poping begins to slow remove from stove and pour into large bowl enjoy go to recipezaar com and give five star rating

name: Popcorn biscotti
ingredients: cooking spray|eggs|vanilla|flour|sugar|baking soda|salt|popped popcorn|raisins
steps: preheat oven to 300 f spray two baking sheets with cooking spray set aside beat eggs and vanilla together in a large mixing bowl sift together flour , sugar , baking soda and salt stir flour mixture thoroughly into egg mixture stir in popcorn and raisins , if desired dough will be sticky spread a little flour on a work surface turn dough out onto work surface and divide into 3 equal pieces sprinkle flour over dough as needed to prevent sticking and roll each piece of dough into a log about 8 inches long and 2 inches wide transfer logs to baking sheets , allowing space between for spreading bake 30 minutes and remove from oven allow cookie logs to cool about 5 minutes and transfer to cutting surface cut logs diagonally into 1 / 2 inch slices place cookies back on baking sheets in a single layer return cookies to oven and bake 20 minutes , turning cookies over after 10 minutes cool cookies on racks and store in an air-tight container

name: Popcorn gator and aioli
ingredients: alligator tail steaks|salt & freshly ground black pepper|cayenne pepper|plain flour|buttermilk|corn oil|red chilies|red pepper|mayonnaise|lemon, juice of
steps: prick the chillies all over with a small sharp knife , and put them and the pepper directly over the flame of your hob , in a dry griddle pan or under a hot grill you need to blacken them all over when they are blistered and black , and look ruined , pop them into a sandwich bag or a bowl covered with cling film to steam the skin off after about ten minutes peel away the skins , deseed them , and chop them fine stir into the mayo with a touch of sea salt and a squeeze of lemon juice toss the meat with a good pinch of salt , pepper and the cayenne get two bowls , and put the buttermilk in one and the flour in the other toss the meat into the flour , shake off the excess , then dip into the buttermilk , then back into the flour pour the oil into a large pan or wok and heat until it reaches 180 degrees cook the meat in batches and fry for about 3-4 minutes , then remove with a slotted spoon drain on kitchen towel and sprinkle with sea salt serve with the aioli and a cold beer !

name: Popcorn stove top
ingredients: oil|popcorn|butter|salt
steps: put the oil in a 4 quart heavy pot and let it heat over medium heat for 30 seconds stir in the kernels , turning with a spoon so that they are evenly covered with oil , then spread them in one layer on the bottom of the pot cover the pot , leaving a small space at the edge for escaping steam as soon as the first kernel pops , move the pot gently and continuously back and forth over medium-high heat until the popping stops turn into a warm bowl toss with melted butter , if desired , and salt to taste

name: Popcorn and peanuts
ingredients: honey|butter|popped popcorn|salted peanuts
steps: heat honey and butter until blended mix popcorn and peanuts in a large bowl and stir in the honey / butter mixture spread mixture into a large roasting pan and bake at 350 for 10 minutes

name: Popcorn balls
ingredients: butter|brown sugar|karo syrup|sweetened condensed milk|vanilla|popped corn
steps: bring to boil butter , sugar , syrup add condensed milk- boil 5 minute remove from heat and add vanilla strain seeds from popcorn pour hot mixture over popcorn and mix grease hands and make balls out of mixture extra to remove the seeds , i usually take two bowls and lift out the popcorn by the hand fulls and shaking it , then dumping it into the extra bowl when i get to the bottom , there lies most of the seeds i just discard them and go on with the rest hope you can visualize that and that it helps !

name: Popcorn balls a special treat for halloween
ingredients: popped corn|sugar|water|light corn syrup|salt|butter|vanilla
steps: mix sauce ingredients [except the vanilla ! ] in a saucepan cook to 250 degrees on a candy thermometer for popcorn balls [or until a few drops form a hard ball when dropped into cold water] this can be cooked to a lower temp if you are just going to drizzle this over popcorn in a pan for smaller bite-sized pieces - and don't want to break a tooth on the hard-ball caramel remove from heat now stir in 1 tsp vanilla pour in a thin stream over the popped corn , stirring constantly to mix well shape into balls , if desired

name: Popcorn balls fit for more than just kids
ingredients: popped corn|molasses|sugar|vanilla|water|vinegar|salt|butter
steps: in a saucepan boil molasses , sugar , water , vinegar , and salt without stirring until it reaches 270 degrees take off the heat and add the butter and vanilla pour the syrup over the popped corn gradually while stirring grease your hands and form the mixture into balls the size of your fist wait to cool and then wrap each individually in wax paper enjoy !

name: Popcorn bars
ingredients: semi-sweet chocolate chips|shortening|butter|miniature marshmallows|butterscotch chips|popped popcorn
steps: in a microwave or double boiler , melt chocolate chips and shortening chill for 15-20 minutes until thickened line a 9 inch square baking pan with foil making sure that the foil extends over the sides of the pan grease the foil in the pan and set aside in a saucepan over low heat , melt butter stir in marshmallows and butterscotch chips until melted and smooth place the popcorn in a large bowl add marshmallow mixture and toss until coated firmly press half of the popcorn mixture into prepared pan spread chocolate mixture evenly over popcorn firmly press remaining popcorn mixture over chocolate chill for 30 minutes lift out of pan using foil edges that are extended over the sides remove foil cut into bars

name: Popcorn bread
ingredients: boiling water|milk|dry yeast|sugar|popped popcorn|salt|eggs|butter|all-purpose flour
steps: combine water and milk in a large bowl stir in yeast and sugar and let them "work" about 10 minutes run popcorn through a blender or food processor until it is the consistency of cornmeal add popcorn and salt to the mixture in the bowl then add eggs and cooled melted butter and gradually work in all 7 cups of flour if you don't have a machine , knead the mixture well by hand let dough rise punch it down then let rise once more put dough out onto a rolling board separate into 3 equal pieces roll into shape and place in greased bread pans let rise until doubled in size bake at 350 degrees f for 35-40 minutes or until loaves are golden brown remove from oven and butter the crusts

name: Popcorn butter supreme
ingredients: butter|tabasco sauce
steps: melt butter and tobassco together spoon over popped popcorn

name: Popcorn cake
ingredients: unbuttered and unsalted popcorn|miniature marshmallow|margarine|oil|gumdrop
steps: pop popcorn to make 6 quarts melt and stir marshmallows , margarine and oil pour over popcorn and small gumdrops fill greased angel pan and press down firmly delicious ! !

name: Popcorn cauliflower
ingredients: cauliflower|salt|sugar|onion powder|garlic powder|paprika|turmeric|oil
steps: preheat oven to 450 degrees toss cauliflower with oil and spice mixture bake 30-35 minutes uncovered

name: Popcorn chicken
ingredients: plain flour|chili peppers|paprika|onion powder|thyme|marjoram|basil|parsley|pepper|garlic powder|english mustard powder|chicken seasoning|salt|milk|chicken breasts|vegetable oil
steps: mix the all dry ingredients together in a bowl , then put a 1 / 4 of the mix in one of the bowls and mix with the milk until a med thick batter , at this stage you can taste the batter to see if it need more chilli or salt just a tiny bit will let you know if it needs more or not wash the chicken and cut into small nugget / popcorn size pieces put your cut chicken in the bowl with the seasoned batter and mix well let it sit for 20-40 minutes heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or deep-fat fryer to 180c using a fork pick out the chicken piece by piece and dip the chicken pieces in the dry flour mixture , cover with flour and fry , in batches , for 8 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through drain on kitchen paper , sprinkle with salt and serve

name: Popcorn cookies
ingredients: butter|sugar|egg|vanilla extract|all-purpose flour|baking soda|salt|popped popcorn|semi-sweet chocolate chips|pecans
steps: in a large bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy beat in egg and vanilla combine the flour , baking soda and salt gradually add to the creamed mixture stir in the popcorn , chocolate chips and pecans drop by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheets bake at 350 for 13-14 minutes or until golden brown remove to wire racks to cool

name: Popcorn crunch
ingredients: popped popcorn|pecan halves|whole almond|sugar|light corn syrup|margarine|dipping chocolate
steps: mix together popped corn and nuts in a saucepan , combine sugar , corn syrup , and margarine bring to a boil , and boil 10 to 15 minutes , stirring constantly when mixture turns light caramel in color , remove from heat , and stir in popcorn and nuts spread out on a lightly greased cookie sheet break apart when cool can be dipped or spread with chocolate , if desired makes about 40 pieces cooking time does not include popping the popcorn

name: Popcorn cupcakes so cute
ingredients: cupcake|icing|mini marshmallows|yellow food coloring
steps: frost the cupcake with white icing to create each piece of "popcorn , " cut one mini marshmallow in half and squish the two pieces back together into a whole mini marshmallow , pinching firmly pile the finished popcorn onto the frosted cupcake for a buttery look , either dilute a drop of yellow food coloring in water and brush it on with a clean paintbrush or mix pastel yellow marshmallows in with the white to make the band , cut a strip of construction paper about 1 1 / 4 inches by 8 inches , or to fit your cupcake , and decorate as shown if you're creating many cupcakes , design just one band and color photocopy it wrap the band around the cupcake and secure with tape

name: Popcorn de provence
ingredients: popped popcorn|butter|garlic cloves|herbes de provence
steps: melt butter in small saucepan add garlic and cook 1 minute stir in herbs de provence place popcorn in large bowl toss flavored butter mixture over popcorn serve immediately

name: Popcorn drops
ingredients: popped popcorn|egg whites|baking powder|salt|cream of tartar|sugar substitute
steps: place popped corn in food processor or food grinder grind into kernel-size pieces beat egg whites until frothy and add baking powder , salt and cream of tartar beat into stiff peaks add sugar replacement , beating until well blended fold popcorn pieces into stiffly beaten egg whites drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets bake at 350 f for 12 to 14 minutes or until lightly browned yield 36 cookies

name: Popcorn for breakfast
ingredients: popped popcorn|milk
steps: add freshly popped popcorn to a cereal bowl pour over milk eat like cereal ! yum !

name: Popcorn granola
ingredients: quick-cooking oats|popcorn|golden raisin|mixed dried fruit|sunflower seeds|margarine|light brown sugar|honey|ground cinnamon|ground nutmeg
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f spread oats on an ungreased baking sheet & bake 10-15 minutes or until lightly toasted in a large bowl , combine oats , popcorn , raisins , dried fruit & sunflower seeds in a small saucepan , combine margarine , sugar , honey , cinnamon & nutmeg & heat over a medium setting until margarine is melted drizzle over popcorn mixture , then toss to coat best when served right away !

name: Popcorn gumdrop cake
ingredients: miniature marshmallows|vegetable oil|butter|popped popcorn|gumdrops|peanuts
steps: in a large saucepan , melt marshmallows , oil and butter until smooth in a large bowl , combine popcorn , gumdrops and peanuts add marshmallow mixture and mix well press into a greased 10 inches tube pan cover and refrigerate for 5 hours or overnight dip pan in hot water for 5-10 seconds to unmold slice cake with an electric or serrate knife

name: Popcorn marshmallow kisses
ingredients: marshmallow creme|peanut butter|milk|popped popcorn|salted peanuts|chocolate
steps: preheat oven to 350 lightly grease a cookie sheet in a large mixing bowl , combine marshmallow creme , peanut butter , and milk stir until smooth add popcorn and peanuts coat evenly lightly grease hands and form popcorn mixture into 2-inch balls place on cookie sheet bake 5 to 7 minutes cool on cookie sheet at least 20 minutes for a festive presentation , stack the balls like a christmas tree and drizzle with chocolate

name: Popcorn muffins
ingredients: flour|popcorn|baking powder|salt|sugar|butter|milk|egg
steps: sift flour , powder , salt and sugar together add milk , popcorn and egg , well beaten , and melted butter bake at 25 minutes at 350 in greased or lined muffin tins

name: Popcorn nibble mix
ingredients: popcorn|dried apricots|dried apples|milk chocolate chips|pepitas
steps: put the popcorn , dried apricots , dried apples , chocolate bits and pepitas into a bowl and mix well to combine store the nibble mix in an airtight container

name: Popcorn owls
ingredients: popped popcorn|sugar|water|light corn syrup|salt|butter|white vinegar|marshmallow creme|candy corn|candy orange slices|miniature m&m baking bits|black licorice
steps: place popcorn in a large bowl keep warm in a 200 f oven in a heavy saucepan , combine the sugar , water , corn syrup and salt cook over medium heat until a candy thermometer reads 250 f remove from the heat stir in butter and vinegar until butter is melted immediately pour over popcorn toss to coat when mixture is cool enough to handle , quickly shape into five 3-1 / 4-in balls and five 4-in balls , dipping hands in cold water to prevent sticking flatten bottom of popcorn balls slightly for stability place a small ball on top of a large ball , forming the owls head and body immediately decorate owl , using marshmallow creme to attach candies add candy corn for claws press the orange slices into sides for wings flatten and cut additional orange slices to make triangle ears and nose and 3 / 4-in circular eyes press m&ms into orange circles to complete the eyes add a 3-in licorice strip above eyes

name: Popcorn s mores
ingredients: light brown sugar|butter|corn syrup|baking soda|popped popcorn|mini marshmallows|graham crackers|chocolate chips
steps: combine the brown sugar , butter , and corn syrup in a medium saucepan and cook over high heat for 5 minutes remove from the heat and stir in the baking soda combine the popcorn and the marshmallows in a large metal or heat-resistant glass bowl drizzle the sugar mixture mixture over the popcorn , then gently stir in the graham cracker cookies and chocolate chips let the mixture set until cool enough to handle , then using buttered plastic sandwich bags on your hands , form the mixture into golf-ball-sized balls store in an airtight container

name: Popcorn salad
ingredients: mayonnaise|celery|cheddar cheese|sliced water chestnuts|cooked bacon|carrot|chives|popped popcorn
steps: in large bowl , combine the mayo , celery , 1 cup of cheese , water chestnuts , 1 / 2 cup bacon , carrots and chives mix well add popcorn stir to coat spoon into a lettuce-lined bowl top with remaining cheese and bacon serve immediately

name: Popcorn salad 2
ingredients: celery|radish|green onion|sliced water chestnuts|bacon|ripe olives|lettuce|microwave popcorn|sharp cheddar cheese|mayonnaise
steps: combine celery , radishes , onion , water chestnuts , bacon and chives in large bowl and mix well set aside when ready to serve , add lettuce pop popcorn and add immediately to the vegetables along with cheese and mayonnaise toss until mayonnaise is evenly distributed

name: Popcorn seasoning mixes
ingredients: paprika|onion powder|garlic powder|salt|fresh ground black pepper|cayenne pepper|chili powder|ground cumin|parmesan cheese|dried oregano|red pepper flakes|curry powder|turmeric
steps: place all of the ingredients in a medium bowl stir until they are combined , and transfer to an airtight container for storage season popcorn to taste

name: Popcorn shrimp salad
ingredients: mayonnaise|cornichons|mustard|hot sauce|pepper|medium shrimp|egg|instant flour|cajun seasoning|kosher salt|vegetable oil|romaine lettuce hearts|tomatoes|red onion|green bell pepper
steps: make the dressing: whisk the mayonnaise , cornichons and their liquid , mustard , hot sauce , and salt and pepper to taste in a bowl prepare the salad: halve the shrimp lengthwise whisk the egg and 2 tablespoons water in a medium bowl in another bowl , whisk the flour , cajun seasoning and 2 teaspoons salt heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a deep skillet until a deep-fry thermometer registers 350 degrees dip each shrimp in the egg mixture , then dredge in the flour mixture working in batches , fry the shrimp until crisp and golden , turning once , about 2 minutes remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper-towel-lined plate season with salt toss the romaine , tomato , onion and bell pepper with the dressing in a large bowl season with salt and pepper divide the salad among plates and scatter the shrimp on top

name: Popcorn shrimp winter salad
ingredients: popcorn shrimp|green leaf lettuce|granny smith apple|blue cheese|walnuts|fresh ground black pepper|balsamic vinaigrette
steps: prepare the shrimp according to package directions divide lettuce among bowls add apple , blue cheese crumbles and walnuts top salads with shrimp and drizzle with dressing

name: Popcorn snack
ingredients: pecan halves|blanched almond|popped popcorn|sugar|butter|corn syrup|cream of tartar|baking soda|rum
steps: heat oven to 300f spread nuts on a cookie sheet and toast lightly , about 10-15 minutes cool mix with popcorn in a large buttered bowl combine sugar , butter , corn syrup , and cream of tartar in a heavy saucepan boil for 5 minutes , or until mixture reaches hard ball stage remove from heat , stir in baking soda and flavoring pour over popcorn mixture mix with a large spatula to coat popcorn and nuts turn out on a large buttered cookie sheet and press lightly cool until hard , break into pieces

name: Popcorn snack mix no nuts
ingredients: popped popcorn|sultanas|dried apricot|nutri-grain cereal|pawpaw
steps: combine all ingredients and serve

name: Popcorn snacking mix
ingredients: popped popcorn|cheerios toasted oat cereal|chex cereal|salted peanuts|brown sugar|corn syrup|butter|vanilla|baking soda
steps: preheat oven to 250 degrees grease a large roasting pan and pour in popcorn , cereals , and peanuts , stir to combine in a large saucepan , combine brown sugar , corn syrup and butter and bring to a rolling boil boil for 6 minutes , stirring frequently remove from heat and quickly stir in vanilla and soda until light and foamy immediately pour over popcorn mixture and stir until coated well bake uncovered for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes or so cool completely

name: Popcorn smores
ingredients: brown sugar|butter|corn syrup|baking soda|popped popcorn|mini marshmallows|teddy grahams honey graham snacks|chocolate chips
steps: combine the brown sugar , butter and corn syrup in a medium saucepan cook on high for 5 minutes remove the pan from the heat and stir in the baking soda thoroughly combine the popcorn and marshmallows in a large metal bowl drizzle the sugar mixture over the popcorn to coat it gently stir in the graham crackers and chocolate chips , incorporating them evenly throughout the mixture let the mixture set until cool enough to handle , then , using buttered plastic sandwich bags on your hands , form the mixture into golf-ball-size balls store in airtight container it will melt when combined with the hot sugar mixture

name: Popcorn toppers cocoa
ingredients: microwave popcorn|hot chocolate powder|peanut butter chips
steps: pop popcorn let popcorn cool slightly in the bag first , then toss in flavorings and shake up

name: Popcorn twist caramel corn
ingredients: butter|brown sugar|corn syrup|baking soda|popcorn
steps: prehead oven to 250f place entire bag of popcorn twists into a large roaster in a large sauce pan , cook together butter , brown sugar and corn syrup for 2 minutes after butter has melted and it starts to gently boil add baking soda to mixture this will cause mixture to foam - that is why you need a large saucepaan allow to foam to cook down slightly pour caramel mixture over popcorn twists and stir until mixed place in oven for 35-45 minutes , , stirring at least every 10-15 minutes remove from oven and pour on wax paper allow to cool slightly and break apart

name: Popcorn with an attitude
ingredients: ground black pepper|white pepper|cayenne pepper|paprika|salt|butter|popcorn
steps: while the corn is popping , mix the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl , drizzle 1 / 2 of the butter over the freshly popped corn and toss sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the pepper mix and toss well until evenly coated repeat with the remaining butter and pepper mix

name: Popcorn with lime and chili
ingredients: vegetable oil|popcorn|chili powder|limes, juice of
steps: heat the oil in a large , heavy pan until it is very hot add the popcorn and cover with lid reduce the heat shake the pan occasionally so all the corn will cook and it will not brown when the popping sound stops , remove pan from the heat and let cool slightly discard any kernels that have not popped add the chili powder shake the pan again and again to make sure that all of the corn is covered with chili powder transfer to a bowl add lime juice just before serving

name: Popcorn with parmesan and pecorino
ingredients: vegetable oil|popcorn|butter|parmesan cheese|pecorino romano cheese|salt
steps: pop the popcorn using a large , heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid or a popcorn maker coat the bottom of the pot with vegetable oil and heat over medium heat drop in 1 kernel of corn and when it pops add the remaining corn , cover and shake pan continue to shake pan until all the corn has popped , being careful not to burn transfer the popped popcorn to a large bowl drizzle with the melted butter and sprinkle with the cheeses toss gently to mix well and serve immediately enjoy !

name: Popcorn with rosemary infused oil
ingredients: popcorn|salt|olive oil|fresh rosemary
steps: stir in popcorn kernels and 1 / 2 cup of the oil in a heavy large pot cover and cook over medium heat until kernels have poped , shaking the pot halfway through cooking , about 3 minutes immediately transfer the popcorn to a large serving bowl toss the popcorn with the remaining 2 tablespoons oil sprinkle with salt , to taste , and serve rosemary infused oil:combine the oil with rosemary in a heavy small saucepan cook over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes remove from heat and let cool to room temperature transfer the sprigs to a 4-ounce bottle or crute add oil and seal with lid refrigerate for up to 1 month

name: Popeye pasta
ingredients: pasta|olive oil|garlic cloves|lemon juice|baby spinach|parmesan cheese|grape tomatoes
steps: cook pasta according to package directions drain put in large serving bowl in a large skillet heat over medium heat heat one tablespoon oil and add garlic and 1 tablespoon lemon juice , cook for one minutes , stirring increase heat to medium high and add spinach , stirring for 2-3 minutes until spinach is limp remove from heat toss with pasta in a medium bowl , combine remaining oil and lemon juice stir in cheese and tomatoes add dressing / tomato mixture to pasta / spinach and toss season with salt and pepper , if desired

name: Popeye pasta with feta cheese
ingredients: angel hair pasta|boiling water|salt|olive oil|roma tomatoes|garlic cloves|fresh spinach|balsamic vinegar|fresh marjoram|granulated sugar|pepper|feta cheese
steps: cook pasta in boiling water and first amount of salt in a large uncovered pot or dutch oven for 6 minutes until tender but firm drain return to pot add first amount of olive oil toss keep warm meanwhile , saute tomato and garlic in second amount of olive oil in large frying pan for about 2 minutes until tomatoes have released their juices add next 6 ingredients heat and stir for about 1 minute just until spinach is wilted and heated through pour over pasta add feta cheese toss well

name: Popeye patties
ingredients: frozen chopped spinach|cottage cheese|corn flakes|parmesan cheese|mayonnaise|ketchup|eggs|salt|pepper|olive oil|cheese
steps: combine all ingredients , except oil and cheese in a medium mixing bowl using about 1 / 3 cup , shape mixture into 6 patties in a large skillet over medium heat , heat oil cook patties about 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown top with cheese of your choice

name: Popeye split pea soup
ingredients: split peas|water|sweet potato|onion|garlic cloves|salt|fresh cracked pepper|fresh spinach|evaporated skim milk|dried savory|dry sherry
steps: soak peas 8 hours or overnight drain and rinse combine with the rest in a pot bring to a boil reduce cover partially simmer 4-5 hours or until thick and creamy yum !

name: Popeye s breakfast bake
ingredients: ramen noodles|margarine|olive oil|onion|red bell pepper|ham|oregano|frozen spinach|eggs|salt|pepper|half-and-half|parmesan cheese|sour cream
steps: cook ramen noodles in boiling water fro 1-2 minute squeeze thawed spinach to remove all water , you should end up with 1 / 4 cup spinach in a small skillet heat olive oil , add onion , red pepper , ham & oregano heat until onions are transparent add drained spinach to skillet , cook for 2 minute lightly whip eggs , salt & pepper , and half-half mixture in a small bowl rub the bottom and sides of a 1-1 / 2 quart casserole or 8"x8" baking dish with margarine place drained ramen noodles in baking dish , then ham & spinach mix , then egg mixture and lastly top with parmesan cheese with a fork slightly break through the mixture allowing the egg mixture to spread to the bottom of the dish bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30-35 minutes or until casserole begins to set and puffs up , garnish with sour cream if desired

name: Popeye s cajun rice copycat
ingredients: lean ground beef|green bell pepper|green onion|garlic powder|dried celery flakes|cajun seasoning|red pepper flakes|cooked long-grain rice|water|black pepper
steps: in a skillet , combine the ground beef and green pepper and cook over medium-high heat until the beef loses its pink color and the pepper is soft pour off the excess fat and reduce the heat to medium-low add the remaining ingredients , then stir and cook together until the ground beef is completely cooked and the liquid is absorbed , 25 to 35 minutes

name: Popeye s favorite
ingredients: spinach|onion|pine nuts|oil
steps: wash your spinach well and clip off course stems leave some moisture on the leaves lightly spray your wok with oil saute onions until golden medium heat add pine nuts for 2 min just before serving add spinach , mix well with the onions& nuts cover for about 2 min the spinach should be just wilted and warm serve immediately

name: Popeye s favorite muscle booster sandwich spinach chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast|egg|water|breadcrumbs|salt and pepper|vegetable oil|garlic cloves|fresh spinach|lemon juice|nutmeg|portabella mushrooms|sweet onions|tomatoes|cheese|focaccia bread
